release.notes: Improves the private Student Portal with easier eight-character access codes, the short students.ljbtalino.com address for configured portals, a searchable learner access list by section, Excel master-list downloads and individual access slips in a ZIP. Adds published subject attendance with term dates, subject filters and attendance totals. Excludes General attendance from learner profiles, subject menus and new online copies while preserving stored records. Includes all previously unpackaged portal improvements. After installing, publish selected sections again to include attendance; missing term dates must first be configured in Settings. Existing records, settings, activation and access codes are preserved. No classroom records upload automatically; publishing credentials are not bundled.
